title: Supplies positive-population recheck on current Last War v21

finding.result: Every sampled server completed the strict Treasure-family 2500/2500 full-world scan with zero scan failure/unread condition, but no authentic WorldSuppliesPoint row was published. Supplies positive-row acceptance therefore remains population-gated rather than failed implementation.

proofBehavior: LiveTreasureStateRefreshProof was reused unchanged with LWBRIDGE_REQUIRE_SUPPLIES=1 and LWBRIDGE_SUPPLIES_TARGET_SERVER. It verifies the automatic fast full-world strategy, target-server context, positive WorldSuppliesPoint population, state refresh coverage, and explicit return to the original server.
limits: This evidence proves clean complete scans and absent sampled population, not that Supplies can never exist on these servers at another time.
No positive Supplies row was available, so B13/B14/C01 positive-row field/filter/state acceptance is not promoted.
Process runtime includes owned lifecycle startup/cleanup and cross-server travel when applicable; it is not a scan SLA.
